create_dataclass_subclass: create a python dataclass that subclasses BaseDataClass to gain the _replace method
replace_dataclass_fields: replace specific fields of a BaseDataClass subclass instance using the _replace method
review_BASEDATACLASS: review the BaseDataClass and its _replace method for dataclass field mutation patterns
refactor_BASEDATACLASS: refactor the BaseDataClass _replace method to add validation before calling dataclasses.replace
test_BASEDATACLASS: test the BaseDataClass _replace method to verify it returns a new instance with updated fields
